description.content: Interact with a Workspace's Work Queues.

Creates a new work queue for the default agent work pool.

If a work queue with the same name already exists, an error
will be raised.

Required workspace scopes: `see_work_queues`

Updates an existing work queue.

Required workspace scopes: `write_work_queues`

Get a work queue by id.

Required workspace scopes: `see_work_queues`

Delete a work queue by id.

Required workspace scopes: `manage_work_queues`

Get a work queue by id.

Required workspace scopes: `see_work_queues`

Get flow runs from the work queue.

Required workspace scopes: `see_work_queues`
